text:
Nina (Finance): Quick escalationreseller migration created a hold tag on partner credits. Close is Fri EOD. Do we estimate and book an accrual or wait for billing clearance? Need to propose to auditors today.

Omar (Billing Ops): We blocked ~95 partner credit memos from Stripe with metadata `hold_due_to_migration`. Typical items are monthly usage credits and one-off onboarding rebates. Example credit memo: CM-26-1125 for partner `ResellCo` shows credit of $9,750.

Tara (Revenue Accounting): Accounting view: if the credit reduces consideration and is contractual/likely, accrue as contra-revenue. If it's a billing system timing issue and contract still requires payment unchanged, we might instead adjust net AR/DR. Need evidence of contract terms and an estimate.

Nina (Finance): I ran a quick bucketization: total billed gross $980,000 across affected invoices; estimated partner credit liability $38,400 (conservative). I can prepare a backup schedule. Should we use a fixed-rate methodology (e.g., % of billed per contract clause) or invoice-level review?

Sam (Controller): For speed, invoice-level review is ideal but not scalable before close. Approve a roll-forward accrual using contract % for now, with a reconciliation run next week to true-up. Proposed JE if we accrue: Dr Sales returns & allowances (4201) $38,400; Cr Accrued partner credits (2508) $38,400. Please include memos for auditors with sample invoices and the SQL extract.

Omar (Billing Ops): SQL we used to pull the hold set: 
```
-- held partner credits
select id, partner_name, amount, metadata->>'hold_reason'
from credit_memos
where metadata->>'hold_due_to' = 'reseller_migration';
```
I'll export CSV with full detail to /shared/finance/escrows/holds_2026-03-21.csv.

Tara (Revenue Accounting): Add a column for `contract_reference` and `contracted_rebate_pct` in the export. We'll apply the % to billed where invoice-level rebate not explicit. For sample documentation include top-5 partner agreements.

Nina (Finance): Action items: 1) Omar export with contract refs and upload by 4pm. 2) Tara to compute accrual schedule and attach calculation workbook. 3) Sam to pre-approve JE for posting pending file review. 4) We'll flag reversal logic (post-close true-up) in close checklist.

close-bot: Reminder: "post accruals" step due in 18 hours for period 2026-03. See https://redwood.internal/close/2026-03/tasks/34

Sam (Controller): I'm comfortable with the proposed JE and control steps. Post accrual tag should be `CLOSE-ACCRUAL-2026-03-PARTNER`. Once uploaded I need the CSV and the contract excerpts.

Omar (Billing Ops): Uploaded CSV and highlighted top 5 partners by exposure. File link: https://files.redwood/internal/finance/holds_2026-03-21.csv. Noted 3 partners have pending disputes; those we will flag as "contested" and exclude if material.

Tara (Revenue Accounting): Draft accrual workbook v0.2 uploaded: /finance/docs/accruals/2026-03/reseller_credit_accrual_v0.2.xlsx. Methodology tab shows %s per contract and rounding rules.

Nina (Finance): I'm assembling the auditor memo now. I'll include: total estimate, data extract, contract mapping, JE proposed, and post-close reversal procedure. Will request sign-off here once memo ready.

Sam (Controller): Thanks. Please @me when memo is in the close folder. If anything pushes materiality thresholds we'll escalate to SOX gate.

Nina (Finance): Will do. Tentative plan: accrue $38,400 unless contested items sum > $5k after Omar's final notes. Updating thread later today.
